verdict.rationale: Cline Kanban runs multiple coding agents in parallel, each in an isolated git worktree, and lets you review each card's diff in a detail view. That gives you the building blocks to run several attempts side by side and inspect them before merging one. However, the docs describe parallel work on separate task cards, not multiple attempts at the same task with a side-by-side compare-and-pick flow. Subagents are research helpers that report back to the main agent, not competing attempts. Missing for 10: an explicit best-of-N or multiple-attempts-per-task workflow, a side-by-side comparison and selection UI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
